info.name: Assessly Backend API
info.description:
# Assessly Backend API

A developer assessment platform backend built with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Stripe.

## Roles
- **CANDIDATE** — Takes assessments, pays for attempts, views results
- **REVIEWER** — Creates assessments, manages questions, evaluates submissions
- **ADMIN** — Manages users, views stats, monitors audit logs

## Auth
All protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

## Response Format
**Success:** `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {}, "meta": {} }`
**Error:** `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": [] }`

## Demo Credentials
| Role | Email | Password |
|---|---|---|
| Admin | testeradmin@gmail.com | Tester@admin12345 |
| Reviewer | testerreviewer@gmail.com | Tester@reviewer12345 |
| Candidate | testercandidate@gmail.com | Tester@candidate12345 |

## Stripe Test Card
`4242 4242 4242 4242` — any future expiry, any CVC, any ZIP.

item.name: 01 - Authentication

request.description:
Registers a new candidate account.

**Auth:** Public

**Body:**
- `name` (string, 2-80 chars)
- `email` (valid email, lowercased)
- `password` (8-72 chars, must include upper, lower, digit)

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Candidate registered successfully",
  "data": {
    "user": { "id", "name", "email", "role", "status" },
    "accessToken": "...",
    "refreshToken": "..."
  }
}
```
Logs in the seeded admin account. Saves `adminAccessToken` for admin requests.
Logs in the seeded reviewer account. Saves `reviewerAccessToken` for reviewer requests.
Logs in the seeded candidate account. Saves `candidateAccessToken` for candidate requests.

Authenticates via Google ID token (from Google Identity Services).

**Body:**
- `credential` — Google ID token (JWT) with `aud` matching `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.

**Auth:** Public (requires valid refresh token in body)
Invalidates the refresh token by incrementing `tokenVersion` on the user, revoking all sessions.

item.description: Handles user registration, login (email/password + Google), token refresh, and logout. All endpoints are public.

request.description:
Creates a new assessment in DRAFT status.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

**Body:**
- `title` (string, 3-150)
- `slug` (lowercase kebab-case, unique)
- `description` (string, 20-5000)
- `difficulty` (JUNIOR | MID | SENIOR)
- `durationMinutes` (5-480)
- `passingScore` (0-100)
- `feeCents` (0-10000000)
- `currency` (3-letter, lowercased)

Lists assessments managed by the authenticated reviewer (or all for admins).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

Returns full assessment detail (including questions and attempt counts) for management.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

Updates an assessment. Blocked if any attempts exist (content locked).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

**Errors:**
- 409 — Attempts exist or assessment is ARCHIVED

Publishes a DRAFT assessment. Requires at least one active question with positive total points.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

**Errors:**
- 409 — No questions, zero points, or already ARCHIVED

Soft deletes an assessment (sets `deletedAt`, status ARCHIVED). Blocked if active attempts exist.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

item.description: Assessment CRUD for REVIEWER and ADMIN roles. Reviewers can only manage their own assessments; admins can manage all.

Adds an MCQ question. `correctAnswer` must be one of `options`.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

Adds a CODE question.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

Updates a question. For MCQs, validates that `correctAnswer` matches one of `options`.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

Soft deletes a question (sets `deletedAt`). Blocked if attempts exist.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER or ADMIN)

item.description: Question management for assessments. Blocked if any attempts exist on the parent assessment.

item.name: 06 - Attempts (Candidate)

request.description:
Enrolls the candidate in an assessment.

- Free assessment → status = READY
- Paid assessment → status = PENDING_PAYMENT (must pay before starting)

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

**Errors:**
- 409 — Active attempt already exists

query.description: PENDING_PAYMENT | READY | IN_PROGRESS | SUBMITTED | UNDER_REVIEW | EVALUATED | CANCELLED

request.description:
Lists the authenticated candidate's attempts with pagination and status filter.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

Returns attempt detail. If started, includes all questions and answers.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

Starts an attempt (READY → IN_PROGRESS), sets `startedAt` and `expiresAt` based on assessment duration, and returns the questions.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

**Errors:**
- 409 — Not READY or already started

Saves (upserts) an answer for a question during an in-progress attempt. Auto-scores MCQ answers.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

**Body:**
- `response` (any JSON) — for MCQ use the option string; for TEXT/CODE use a string

**Errors:**
- 409 — Attempt not IN_PROGRESS or expired

Submits an in-progress attempt, computes `autoScore` from MCQ answers, and moves to SUBMITTED (ready for review).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

**Errors:**
- 409 — Not IN_PROGRESS or already submitted

item.description: Candidate assessment attempts: enroll, start, answer, submit.

request.description:
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for a paid assessment attempt.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "paymentId": "...",
    "sessionId": "cs_test_...",
    "checkoutUrl": "https://checkout.stripe.com/..."
  }
}
```

**Test card:** `4242 4242 4242 4242` — any future expiry, any CVC.

**Errors:**
- 409 — Free assessment, already paid, or wrong attempt status

Initiates a Stripe PaymentIntent (alternative to Checkout). Returns `clientSecret` for frontend confirmation.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

**Body (optional):**
- `paymentMethodId` — Stripe PaymentMethod ID for immediate confirmation

Confirms a PaymentIntent with a specific PaymentMethod (used when the frontend collects card details).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

Returns the payment record for a candidate's attempt.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE)

Returns a payment by ID. Candidates see their own; admins see any.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (CANDIDATE or ADMIN)

⚠️ Normally invoked by Stripe, not Postman.

**Recommended local testing:**
```bash
stripe listen --forward-to localhost:5000/api/v1/payments/webhook
```

Handles: `checkout.session.completed`, `checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded`, `checkout.session.expired`, `payment_intent.succeeded`, `payment_intent.payment_failed`, `payment_intent.canceled`, `payment_intent.processing`.

item.description: Stripe payment flow: initiate, confirm, checkout session, and status tracking.

item.name: 08 - Reviews (Reviewer)

request.description:
Lists unclaimed SUBMITTED attempts ready for review.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER)

Atomically claims a SUBMITTED attempt (SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW). Prevents double-claiming.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER)

**Errors:**
- 409 — Already claimed

Returns full attempt detail with all questions and answers for grading. Prints `answerId`s to console.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER)

Lists attempts assigned to the authenticated reviewer (UNDER_REVIEW or EVALUATED).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER)

Submits scores for non-MCQ answers and finalizes the review.

- MCQ answers are auto-scored and skipped
- Non-MCQ answers need `{ answerId, score, feedback? }`
- `score` cannot exceed the question's `points`
- Computes `finalScore` (0-100), determines PASS/FAIL vs `passingScore`, sets attempt status to EVALUATED

**Auth:** Bearer Token (REVIEWER)

**Body:**
- `feedback` (string, 3-5000) — overall feedback
- `answers` (array) — `{ answerId, score, feedback? }` for each non-MCQ answer (get `answerId`s from 8.3)

item.description: Reviewer workflow: view queue, claim attempt, evaluate submission.

item.name: 09 - Admin

request.description:
Lists all users with pagination, search, role/status filter, and sort.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (ADMIN)

Blocks or unblocks a user. Blocking increments `tokenVersion`, revoking all sessions.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (ADMIN)

**Body:**
- `status`: `ACTIVE` or `BLOCKED`

**Errors:**
- 409 — Cannot block your own admin account

Updates a user's role. Revokes all sessions by incrementing `tokenVersion`.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (ADMIN)

**Body:**
- `role`: `CANDIDATE` | `REVIEWER` | `ADMIN`

**Errors:**
- 409 — Cannot remove your own admin role, or user has active assessment work

Soft deletes a user (sets `deletedAt`, status BLOCKED, revokes sessions). Blocked if user has active assessment work.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (ADMIN)

**Errors:**
- 409 — Cannot delete yourself or user has active attempts

Returns aggregate platform statistics: user counts by role, published assessments, attempt totals, evaluated count, and payment totals.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (ADMIN)

Lists audit log entries with pagination and optional action/entityType filter. Includes actor details.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (ADMIN)
